items.name: SYNC-RULE-TOOLING-COMMIT-SCOPE
items.note: Whether CLAUDE.md's and AGENTS.md's sync rule - one paragraph per increment in the current record file, plus AGENTS.md's headline numbers - binds a TOOLING commit that publishes under docs/reports/ without moving a semantic surface or a headline number. Live in wave 33: this close's own deliverables are such a publication, and so was W32-RECONCILE-SWEEP's tool. The rule's text is written for an increment that moves status, and it does not say whether a docs/reports/ publication with no count movement owes a paragraph, owes nothing, or owes a line somewhere else.
items.ground: An interpretation of the sync rule itself, which is a standing rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Constraint-style rule text lands `in the words the card proposed` or is declined with ground (invariant 1); a close resolving an ambiguity in the rule it is being judged by would be authoring rule text for its own benefit. Surfaced for the integrator with the concrete instance named.
